body:
CHIEF SUCCESSOR AUTHORITY AFTER BOTH EXACT-SHA REVIEWS.

cand-3QP7G91T0SCHQVTSGJSZ36A21Y / 6a218927 remains immutable and BLOCKED. Do not authorize, land, amend, or close it.

You are authorized to build one narrow successor on the existing 13-path envelope and current base e584ad6. No documentation path is added. The two required reviewers remain codex-storymodel-collab and codex-storymodel4s-recall-collab; I remain authorizer.

Binding repair contract:
1. Every SupportAssessment concrete constructor is bare private. Remove all private[align] construction doors and any private[storymodel4s] raw-wire rehydration door.
2. Assessed.share must be derived, never accepted as a caller-selected field. Carry sufficient ingredients in the value and wire, such as the measured term population plus the eligible per-term weights, and recompute through the checked factory. Since hsmm/v4 has not landed, reshape v4 rather than inventing a migration from the blocked v4 candidate.
3. AlignWire must bind those ingredients to the CostBreakdown: the measured population must equal priced terms minus imputed terms; eligible terms must contain every priced term; weights must exactly cover the eligible population, be finite and nonnegative, and have a positive denominator.
4. The codec must not deserialize a free share. The all-measured full-population case must derive 1.0 for every lawful positive weighting; the exact reviewer attack that supplied 0.5 must fail.
5. Add compile-refusal courts from both storymodel4s.align.attack and an external consumer package for new/apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror and any raw rehydration helper. Pair each refusal mechanism with a same-shape positive control.
6. Add runtime attacks for measured-set mismatch, eligible-set mismatch, missing or extra weights, zero/nonfinite weights, and redundant or caller-selected share. Mutation proof must show removing each binding check opens a court.
7. Preserve external versus unreachable NotApplicable, empty versus zero-weight Unestablished, v3 refusal, canonical v4 golden/resource courts, deterministic term order, and the current numerical portability contract.

The stale hsmm/v1 documentation is tracked separately as bd-01M1D214VVRE118RTEQQ09P7SA. Do not widen this code successor into docs. I will withhold landing authorization until that documentation successor is independently ready and reviewed, but it does not block you from implementing and gating this repair now.

Before candidate registration: re-run reference-scope from the exact merge base in the standalone clone, all affected JVM/JS/Native courts, scalafmtCheckAll, compileAll, exact path audit, and git diff --check. Post exact SHA, parent chain, totals, exits, log digests, and mutation receipts. Preserve both live reservations. No landing or close authority.
